tasks.title: Fix insertBefore crash capping history at one page
tasks.notes: Root cause matches the user-reported verbatim Chrome NotFoundError: after the first click the insertion-point selector matched a block inside the .chat-history-page wrapper (a grandchild), and insertBefore requires a child reference. Fix scopes both insertion points to direct children, preferring the oldest wrapper so pages stay chronological. go vet/test pass, validate clean, rebuilt and restarted :9090, served app.js confirmed carrying the scoped selectors. Acceptance click-through (hard-reload, 3+ clicks on a >100-message session) left to the user.
